messages:
Hannah: Quick ping 1 1 1 planning a hybrid LAN + couch night Friday. Main goals: Steam Decks + docked monitors, a tiny pub-quiz style gaming tournament (trivia + 3 rounds of local mini-games), and a Smash side bracket. Need a couple of things: 1) 2 USB-C docks for Decks or Switch docks, 2) powerbanks for handhelds, 3) 4 short ethernet cables (1m).
Omar: I have a Gen2 Deck dock and a 1m Cat6 cable. Also can bring a 10k mAh powerbank.
Lia: I can bring another dock (USB-C to HDMI + PD passthrough) and two power bricks. I0ll also make the quiz (10 questions).
Marcus: I0ll bring a spare PS4 pad and a HDMI capture dongle if anyone wants to stream clips. Also happy to run the tournament bracket sheet.
Hannah: Amazing. Anyone else have short HDMI or USB-C cables? The docks like snug cables.
Omar: I0ve got a 0.5m USB-C cable that should work.
Lia: Snack plan: everyone chip in? Suggest: hummus + pita, salsa + chips, fruit bowl. React with emoji if you can bring.
- Hannah: :honey_pot: (hummus)
- Omar: :potato: (chips)
- Marcus: :cookie: (cookies)
- Lia: :banana: (fruit)
build-bot: Room reservation: "Studio" booked by Hannah 18:30-22:30 Friday.
Hannah: Networking note for anyone doing Steam Remote Play or deck-to-PC casting: prefer wired to the guest VLAN (LAN-GUEST). If you need quick local static IP for hosting a lobby, use these commands:```
# mac/linux
sudo ip addr add 192.168.200.20/24 dev en0
# windows (admin)
netsh interface ip set address "Ethernet" static 192.168.200.20 255.255.255.0 192.168.200.1
```
Omar: Also FYI if your Deck is docked but you want local audio split: bring a small 3.5mm splitter or Bluetooth dongle. Deck Bluetooth sometimes lags for local party chat.
Lia: Would anyone be up for a quick network stress test at 18:15 so we can confirm stable lobbies? I can run iperf server.
Marcus: Yes please. I0ll bring a laptop to run iperf client. Sample command:```
iperf3 -c 192.168.200.10 -t 30 -P 4
```
Hannah: Prize for pub-quiz winner = $20 Steam gift card. Runner-up gets a sticker pack. Smash side-moneyless bracket: winner picks the champion sticker.
Omar: Small ask: can we keep volume around 75%? Some folks have late calls. Headphones encouraged.
Lia: Good call. Also if anyone wants to borrow a Switch Pro or a Steam Deck dock during the night, DM me.
Marcus: Final schedule: setup 18:15, network test 18:30-18:45, warm lobbies 19:00, pub-quiz 19:30, mini-game rounds 20:00, Smash bracket 21:00.
Hannah: Thanks team! See you Friday :game_die: :headphones:
